1_POST_EXTENSION_BLOCK_CONTAINMENT.claim: sim_C refines sim_S, hence every large post-extension block U is contained in an old block E
1_POST_EXTENSION_BLOCK_CONTAINMENT.reason: same frozen unary/SI factors; quotient-pair images enlarge from S to C; a subdirect old pair relation contained in an isomorphism graph must already equal that graph

2_TARGET_FAILURE_LIFTS_TO_OLD_BLOCK.claim: y_U notin C_U and U subseteq E imply y_E notin C_E
2_TARGET_FAILURE_LIFTS_TO_OLD_BLOCK.reason: otherwise projection of a witness for y_E in C_E to U would place y_U in C_U

3_PROPER_FACTOR_WITNESS.claim: for old y-failing E, if S<T_E=S[theta^E], a tuple t in T_E\S is a strict global SAFEEXT witness
3_PROPER_FACTOR_WITNESS.reason: y notin T_E; T_E is a subalgebra; Sg(S,t) <= T_E
3_PROPER_FACTOR_WITNESS.construction: T_E is product-congruence saturation; source machinery gives polynomial generators and CompactRep recompaction in the fixed-family scope

4_EQUALITY_FACTOR_STRICTNESS.claim: if S=T_E and a global witness t is outside S, then t_E is outside S_E
4_EQUALITY_FACTOR_STRICTNESS.reason: T_E is exactly the full inverse image of S_E under the selected SI quotient map

5_EXACT_BC_INPUT.claim: the old large block E enumerated by Algorithm 7 is a d-coherent HS(K) input; in the equality branch t_E is both strict and target-safe, exactly the input required by the liftable Lemma B/C solver
5_EXACT_BC_INPUT.coverage: old-skeleton quotient profile -> cross-fibre affine avoidance; quotient-changing profile -> one-original-bundle normalization

6_LOCAL_LIFT_TO_GLOBAL_SAFE.claim: a strict liftable local witness u_E completes to a strict global tuple t and local target exclusion certifies global target exclusion
6_LOCAL_LIFT_TO_GLOBAL_SAFE.reason: u_E outside S_E implies t outside S; projection of y in Sg(S,t) would contradict y_E outside Sg(S_E,u_E)
